title: Concept: Link to an environment file
description: A link whose path ends at /.env in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: An environment file holds database passwords, API keys and signing secrets in plain text, and a link to it turns discovery into a single click.
applicability: Static hosting, framework debug pages and deployment trees that ship the repository root.
risk: Every credential in the file becomes usable, and the file usually names the production database.
